expectations.text: Formula = lait produit / MSI with MSI = MS distribuee - refus (kg lait per kg MS ingeree).
expectations.evidence: efficacite_indicateur.py:16-23 docstring 'Efficacité Alimentaire (sur MS) = Production laitière (L) / MS ingérée (kg)' and 'MS ingérée = ... so "MS ingérée = MS distribuée − refus"', unit L lait/kg MS. NOTES.md:32-54 repeats the formula and 'MSI = MS distribuée − refus. Optimal 1.4 L/kg MS'. Formula and the MSI=distribuée−refus identity are both stated correctly (function efficacite_alimentaire(production, ms) implements lait/MS).

expectations.text: Green threshold = pfe_efficacite_min (1.4) and orange = pfe_efficacite_orange_min (1.0), read via get_config (not hardcoded).
expectations.evidence: efficacite_indicateur.py:104-105 'cfg_eff_min = float(get_config("pfe_efficacite_min", default=1.4))' and 'cfg_eff_omn = float(get_config("pfe_efficacite_orange_min", default=1.0))', with get_config (:40-52) reading HMD Configuration Single via frappe.db.get_single_value. Matches app rapport_mensuel.py:1250-1251 and config defaults (init_pfe_seuils.py:18-19). Not hardcoded into the color branch.

expectations.text: Tri-color green/orange/red decision logic is config-driven.
expectations.evidence: efficacite_indicateur.py:55-76 _kpi_ind higher-is-better branch returns 'Green' (>=green_min), 'Orange' (>=orange_min), 'Red' else, '' for None/0; called as _kpi_ind(valeur, green_min=cfg_eff_min, orange_min=cfg_eff_omn) (:108) with thresholds from get_config (:104-105). rapport_mensuel_formatter.js:27-34 maps Green/Orange/Red to colored cells.

expectations.text: Computes over a defined population (presente/lactante) using live_state for effectif; module 'HMD AGRO'.
expectations.evidence: No reference to live_state, effectif_on_date, présente/lactante populations, or module 'HMD AGRO' anywhere in the without_skill outputs (grep returned zero matches). efficacite_indicateur.py computes a single cheptel-wide value: efficacite_alimentaire(production_litres, ms_ingeree_kg) takes raw scalars; build_efficacite_row (:90-122) takes production/MS directly with no effectif reconstruction and no présente/lactante split. The defined-population + live_state requirement is not met.
